title: Ok
text: Ok. I love putting sachet Packets in drawers, In my car, or anywhere else that needs a Fresh scent. This has a natural lavender scent and the other packets are cedar scented. Cedar packets are good to put in closets and in drawers to keep the moths away. The cedar packets that I received Unfortunately do not have any smell to them.
